## 8. POST-GEN NOTES
- Structure: the first full beat lands at about 0:26; the layout is "Half-time for the last third" and runs about 2:54. The beat switch is one axis ("beat flips at the midpoint"); its words repeat in the head tag and in every section after the switch so Suno cannot undo it.
- No hint on this roll; the hook device in the lead line ("the hook is the lead's phrase with the middle note missing") carries the stickiness. Listen for it on the second pass.
- The kick and snare should sit behind the grid; if the drums sound programmed, re-roll (the kit descriptions already say late and by hand) and raise Weirdness five points.
- The tine piano should sound like a real electric piano, not a pad; if it is a pad, the lead line got cut, so shorten the counter and re-roll.
- Bass should be a bass guitar, not a sub; "808" and "drum machine" are in the Exclude list for this reason.
- Suno likes to hum over soul grooves; the Exclude list handles it, and no vocal-implying word is allowed in this lane.
- Fills, risers or a roll at a section change mean a word slipped through: run the QA checker on the block, and keep the anti-transition phrase in the drums line (it is the positive form of "no fills").
- Any hum, chant or sung syllable means a re-roll, not a fix: the Exclude list is already complete, so change the seed rather than adding words.
- Ending: [End] should stop it near 2:54. If it runs on, Crop to the last downbeat. If it stops early, Extend from the last good section and paste only the remaining section tags.
- Extend when the first 60-90 s are keepers and only the back half drifts. Re-roll (or run the weirder variation on v6-wild) when the drums or the lead are wrong from the start.
- Remaster: Remaster (Pro/Premier) renders subtle variations and runs on v6; use it on the keeper for a cleaner, louder master.
- Stems: Get Stems (Pro/Premier): Auto Split up to 12 stems for 50 credits; Split from Mix 10 credits per stem; Advanced Split (choose from ~100 instruments) 10 credits per stem, Premier only.
- Prompt ignored? Check Variety is Off (v6 defaults it to Normal, which rewrites the Style text) and Max Mode is on. Then check Style Influence is 70 or higher.
